cuts.title: xQc takes a guy's antique gun and shoots him with it

cuts.retelling: xQc's character grabs a man's antique blunderbuster despite his warning that it blows baseball-sized holes, then he and his friends shoot the man in the ankle just to test it, and afterward argue over whose fault the death was.

cuts.hook: Speed begs for one good pull
cuts.retelling: IShowSpeed complains that the game keeps trolling him with bad cards and begs for one good pull, then a gold card ticks up and reveals Dani Olmo, and he erupts in celebration.
